content.text:
Mira settled best swaddled on her back as a young baby, and you dropped the swaddle around 5 months.

That's a pretty typical window — most babies transition out of the swaddle once they start showing signs of rolling, since a loose or worn swaddle becomes a suffocation risk once they can flip over. If you're curious about what came next for her (sleep sack, room setup, etc.), just ask and I can dig into that stretch.
